_about: Stock closed-loop belt pitch lengths, each tagged with its source (ADR-064). Every length is a whole number of teeth (length = teeth x pitch); an entry that is not is rejected. 'purchase_confirmed' stays false until the researcher confirms the belt can actually be ordered. Which sources a belt system may use is named in belt_systems.json (length_sources).
